board: GW25K 16-key touch MIDI keyboard with USB3300, RTL8723DS, NV3007, QT2160, PCA9685 and WS2812
note: Wiring and integrated RTL feature record. This JSON is not a Gowin CST/SDC. Board synthesis, timing/CDC and physical keyboard/USB/BLE/display/LED validation must be assessed separately.
pin_direction_reference: FPGA viewpoint unless a module-relative name is explicitly identified

usb2.physical_reset_note: USB3300 RESET is wired to ground in the board schematic; no FPGA-controlled PHY reset pin is assigned here.
usb2.cdc_requirement: Use asynchronous FIFOs or acknowledged complete-event transfers between 60 MHz ULPI and the 50 MHz core. Do not synchronize packet/event payload bits individually.
usb2.profile: USB-MIDI 1.0 plus independent vendor screen control
usb2.identity_note: Local inherited laboratory identifiers only; obtain authorized product identifiers before distribution.

module_tx.note: Module UART_OUT / BT_TX to FPGA RX

module_rx.note: FPGA TX to module UART_IN / BT_RX

ble.online_condition: Connected and MIDI characteristic CCCD notifications enabled
ble.normal_disconnect: HCI LE Set Advertising Enable command restarts connectable advertising
ble.board_failure_recovery: After failed is continuously high for five seconds, pulse reset and repeat module disable/H5/HCI/full ROM-v2 patch initialization

lcd.reset_note: LCD RST is fixed at 3.3 V, so FPGA reconfiguration does not power-reset the display.
lcd.strip_visualization: right-side vertical bar; fills bottom to top
lcd.spi_timing_source: NV3007 V1.0 section 8.3.2; GW5A ODDRC forwarded 50 MHz mode-0 clock, nominal MOSI setup/hold 10 ns each. Physical board timing unmeasured.

slider_diagnostics.footer: G<general status hex> E<error hex> OV<sticky cycle overrun> N<successful sample counter hex>
slider_diagnostics.general_status: Actual QT2160 register 2. Bit7 RESET, bit6 CYCLE OVERRUN, bit1 CC, bit0 SDET; CC can normally be set.
slider_diagnostics.overrun_latch: Set after any successful status read with bit6=1; cleared by FPGA reset only
slider_diagnostics.sample_counter: 8-bit wrapping counter; only successful complete slider acquisitions count, no baseline/fault samples
slider_diagnostics.coherence: All display fields captured once per frame; raw position is before FPGA jitter/jump filter

rtl_simulation_refresh.scope: Pin-level tests use actual 50 MHz clock and DDR SPI, only initialization waits are accelerated. Measured results are in reports/simulation.log; no physical panel/TE FPS claim.

lcd.refresh_scope: 60 Hz coherent scene updates with exact changed-region RGB565 transfers; arbitrary full-screen changes do not sustain 60 fps
lcd.scene_consistency: Freeze until all selected regions complete. Full repaint supersedes partial regions and can miss a 60 Hz tick; no snapshot replacement during transfer.

remote_input.protocol: PL local-v1 adaptation of user-supplied interface planning documents
remote_input.transport: USB2 vendor interface 2, OUT 0x02 / IN 0x82; MK control remains available
remote_input.highspeed_physical_bus: Unspecified by supplied reference; no new pins assigned
remote_input.pixel_format: RGB565 little-endian logical row-major tiles, LCD sends high byte first
remote_input.input_trigger: Only an accepted DISPLAY_TILE enters input view; enumeration/MIDI/HELLO/HEALTH alone do not
remote_input.fallback: Existing instrument/settings view; complete repaint after remote view
remote_input.settings_override: E1 hold 1000 ms enters latched local settings; hold again requests fresh remote redraw
remote_input.remote_canvas: Black clear on entry; no full framebuffer; host must resend complete scene after reset/timeout/settings
remote_input.draw_completion: FRAME_END succeeds only after the matching last tile is physically complete with LCD CS released
remote_input.link_reset: Invalidate session and remote canvas; keep any already accepted tile RAM immutable until physical completion

encoders.rotation_decoder: A/B pair filtering; two legal transitions per mechanical detent; signed two-detent accumulator cancels opposite motion and resets on an invalid phase jump
encoders.note: E1 short release cycles strip mode in settings; E1 hold toggles remote/settings. E2 press always requests panic.
encoders.e1_rotation: Cycle focus: SHIFT, CH, VEL, STRIP, PROG, LAMP
encoders.e1_press: Short release in local view: MOD -> EXPR -> BEND; no short action after long hold
encoders.e2_press: All-channel CC120, CC123, pitch center; held keys blocked until released
encoders.local_parameter_gate: E1/E2 rotation and E1 short press adjust settings only while local view; E2 panic remains active in both views

touch_protocol.connector: U4, HC-JN254-2-07-Z, 14 pins, same numbered pins on both boards
touch_protocol.i2c_drive: open drain: drive low or release; the three buses remain separate

shared_change.note: Shared notification input, not chip select. Synchronized and serviced by status reads plus periodic polling.

ws2812.note: RTL waveform tested; exact populated V6 3.3 V supply/logic thresholds and physical signal integrity remain unverified.
ws2812.chain_key_order_source: user confirmed 2026-10-17; starts at DIN first pixel
ws2812.input_bitmap_order: logical A=bit0 through P=bit15; independent from physical chain order

touch_protocol.reset_note: Daughterboard U1/U2 RST pin 25 is fixed to 3V3.
touch_protocol.register_driver_verification_scope: Pin-level I2C simulation with slave model, configuration readback, stable key snapshots, slider and fault recovery; no hardware test

pca9685.mapping: position 0: off; otherwise ceil(position/16) channels lit from channel 0
pca9685.release_behavior: MOD/EXPR hold; BEND returns to 128 (8 channels)

physical_key_mapping.reported_numbers: QT2160 raw key bitmap bit indices, zero based (0..15)
physical_key_mapping.logical_bitmap: A=bit0 through P=bit15 for MIDI, screen and WS2812; remap applied exactly once at board top
physical_key_mapping.verification: all 65536 raw bitmaps plus MIDI NoteOn/NoteOff simulation; physical behavior after programming still to be observed

touch_tuning.symptom: user reports oversensitivity, accidental touches and slider jitter

slider.filter_scan_limit: Confirmation reads are at least one nominal LP1 period apart; QT2160 has no exposed scan epoch, so distinct ASIC scans are not guaranteed under acquisition slowdown.

common.shared_change_policy: CHANGE requests a scan only after the minimum interval; counter measures STATUS_BEFORE start to start
common.reset_policy: Read old RESET status before configuring; any RESET afterward invalidates data, releases input, and triggers full reconfiguration

touch_tuning.parameter_interface: separate compile-time KEY_* and SLIDER_* midi_touch_frontend parameters

keyboard_input.note: QT2160 scans feed raw 16-key snapshots, remapped once to user-confirmed A..P order at top, and filtered 8-bit slider values. No velocity sensing; Note On uses adjustable fixed velocity. Hardware touch noise and physical LED direction remain to be validated.
